heuristics: Canonicalized Pollard rho walk modeled as a uniform random function on an m=r/6-element set (standard, supported, not proven).
Fruitless-cycle escape step's overhead is folded into a generous per-step constant rather than computed via the exact Galbraith-Ruprai classification.
Final orbit-ambiguity resolution (up to 6 scalar candidates checked against Q) is charged at its worst case, not its expected case.
limitations: Analytic construction; no full-size execution. experiment.py only exercises the algorithm's collision/canonicalization/escape logic on a toy additive group with a synthetic order-6 automorphism.
The declared T-step budget is fixed and non-adaptive; success probability is exactly 0.39, not higher.
Supersedes but does not invalidate submissions/secp256k1-ecdlp/, which remains historical evidence under retired reference prices per RESCORING.md.
